data.lead: One partner for absence and pay, so a sick report never slips through the cracks.
intro: As soon as an employee is ill, a lot changes on the payslip: continued payment of wages, a second year of illness, sometimes a safety-net benefit or a wage sanction. With a separate payroll provider you have to pass all of that on yourself, and it sometimes goes wrong.
With React2u Reward, payroll sits with the same people who guide the sickness absence. A sick or recovery report automatically lands correctly in the payroll, for a fixed price per employee per year.
herken: You currently report sick leave twice: to the occupational health service and to payroll
Continued payment during illness sometimes goes wrong or late
You want one point of contact for absence and pay
You are looking for a fixed price per employee, without surprises
